name: Lysander
source:
Many people are wary of Lysander because of his aloof attitude. But when one gets to know him, Lysander is actually well-known as a friendly and generous person by the members of his community. While the good rumours proved to be true, there are many others about him speak of sordid past.
[spoiler]His real age is 27.[/spoiler]
translation:
Many people are wary of Lysander because of his aloof attitude. But when one gets to know him, Lysander is actually well-known as a friendly and generous person by the members of his community. While the good rumours proved to be true, there are many others about him speak of sordid past.
[spoiler]His real age is 27.[/spoiler]
